muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿كتاب أنزلناه إليك مبارك ليدبروا آياته وليتذكر أولو الألباب﴾: (كتاب): khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "this is a Book"; the clause ﴿أنزلناه﴾ is an adjective; (أنزل): past verb, ﴿نا﴾: fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿إليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلناه﴾; (مبارك): a second naʿt (adjective), or a second khabar, or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; (ليدبروا): the lām is the lām of purpose (lām al-taʿlīl), and (يدبروا) is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām of purpose, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from «أن» and the verb is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أنزلناه﴾; (آياته): mafʿūl bihi; (وليذكر): conjoined to (ليدبروا) [Translator's note: the source writes «وليذكر» here, whereas the ayah reads ﴿وليتذكر﴾]; (أولو): fāʿil; and (الألباب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿ووهبنا لداود سليمان نعم العبد إنه أواب﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (وهبنا): past verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿لداود﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وهبنا﴾; (سليمان): object; the clause ﴿ووهبنا لداود...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (نعم): an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise, and (العبد) is its fāʿil; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted because it was mentioned before, i.e. "he"; ﴿إنه أواب﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the hāʾ is its noun, and (أواب) is its khabar (predicate); the clause gives the reason for the praise.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿إذ عرض عليه بالعشي الصافنات الجياد﴾: (إذ): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿عرض﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; (عرض): passive past verb; ﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عرض﴾; ﴿بالعشي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being at that time"; (الصافنات): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and (الجياد): a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition).

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿فقال إني أحببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربي حتى توارت بالحجاب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (قال): past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (إن) is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause (أحببت) is its khabar (predicate); (حب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أحببت﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); (الخير): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿عن ذكر﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أحببت﴾; ﴿ربي﴾: muḍāf ilayhi, and the annexation is the annexation of the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its object, i.e. "from my remembering my Lord", or to its agent, i.e. "from my Lord's remembering me"; (حتى): a particle of limit and genitive; (توارت): past verb, and its fāʿil is a latent pronoun, its implied form being "it/she" (هي); and (بالحجاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿توارت﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿ردوها علي فطفق مسحا بالسوق والأعناق﴾: (ردوها): imperative verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is the speech (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying, i.e. "he said: Return them"; (عليّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ردوها﴾; (فطفق): conjoined to something omitted, i.e. "so they returned them"; (طفق): a past verb among the verbs of commencing (afʿāl al-shurūʿ), which operate as kāna operates, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "he" (هو); (مسحًا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e. "he began wiping (يمسح) a wiping", and the clause is the khabar (predicate) of (طفق); (بالسوق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مسحًا﴾; and (الأعناق): conjoined to (بالسوق).

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿ولقد فتنا سليمان وألقينا على كرسيه جسدا ثم أناب﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām occurs in the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath; (قد): a particle of realization (taḥqīq); (فتنا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (سليمان): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ولقد فتنا سليمان﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (ألقينا): conjoined to (فتنا); (على كرسيه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ألقينا﴾, and the hāʾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (جسدًا): mafʿūl bihi; and (ثم أناب): also conjoined.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿قال رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لأحد من بعدي﴾: (رب): the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person yāʾ, which is omitted; (هب): a verb of supplication; (لي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) it; (ملكًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لا ينبغي﴾ is an adjective of (ملكًا); (لأحد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينبغي﴾; and ﴿من بعدي﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (أحد).
﴿إنك أنت الوهاب﴾: the clause gives the reason for the supplication for forgiveness and the gift; (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; (أنت): a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); (الوهاب): khabar (predicate) of (إن), or khabar of (أنت), and [in that case] the clause is the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿فسخرنا له الريح تجري بأمره رخاء حيث أصاب﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (سخرنا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سخرنا﴾; (الريح): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿تجري بأمره﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الريح); (تجري): imperfect verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); (بأمره): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تجري﴾; (رخاء): a ḥāl from the pronoun in (تجري); (حيث): an adverb attached to ﴿تجري﴾; the clause ﴿أصاب﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; and (أصاب): past verb, and the fāʿil is latent.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿والشياطين كل بناء وغواص﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (الشياطين): conjoined to (الريح); (كل): a badal (substitute) from (الشياطين); (بناء): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (غواص): conjoined to (بناء).

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وآخرين مقرنين في الأصفاد﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (آخرين): conjoined to ﴿كل بناء﴾, being included with it in the ruling of the badal (substitute), and it is a badal of the whole from the whole; (مقرنين): a naʿt (adjective) of (آخرين), i.e. some of them were bound together with others in fetters; and (في الأصفاد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مقرنين).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿هذا عطاؤنا فامنن أو أمسك بغير حساب﴾: the clause is the speech (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (عطاؤنا): khabar (predicate), and ﴿نا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (فامنن): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and (امنن) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); ﴿أو﴾: a conjunction of choice; (أمسك): imperative verb conjoined to (امنن); and (بغير): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عطاؤنا﴾, or attached to ﴿امنن﴾, or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from what precedes.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مآب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (عندنا): an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and ﴿نا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (زلفى): the noun of (إن); (حسن): conjoined to (زلفى); and (مآب): muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿واذكر عبدنا أيوب إذ نادى ربه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (اذكر): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (عبدنا): the object of (اذكر), and ﴿نا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أيوب): a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of (عبدنا); (إذ): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from (أيوب); the clause ﴿نادى﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); (ربه): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أني مسني الشيطان بنصب وعذاب﴾: (أن) is an abrogating particle, the yāʾ is its noun, and the clause (مسني الشيطان) is its khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from (أن) and what falls within its scope is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "with [the words]: that Satan has touched me"; ﴿مسني الشيطان﴾: past verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi and a postponed fāʿil; ﴿بنصب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مسني﴾; and (عذاب): conjoined to (نصب).

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿اركض برجلك هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب﴾: the clause is the speech (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying; (اركض): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (برجلك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اركض﴾, and the object of (اركض) is omitted, i.e. "the ground"; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (مغتسل): khabar (predicate); (بارد): an adjective of (مغتسل); and (شراب): conjoined.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿ووهبنا له أهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة منا وذكرى لأولي الألباب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (وهبنا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وهبنا﴾; (أهله): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (مثلهم): conjoined to (أهله); ﴿معهم﴾: an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "being with them"; (رحمة): mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); (منا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of (رحمة); (ذكرى): conjoined to (رحمة); (لأولي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (ذكرى); and (الألباب): muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (خذ): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (بيدك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خذ﴾; (ضغثًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (فاضرب): conjoined to (خذ); (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اضرب﴾, and the object is omitted, i.e. "your wife"; (ولا تحنث): the wāw is a conjunction, (لا) is prohibitive, and (تحنث) is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا).
﴿إنا وجدناه صابرا نعم العبد إنه أواب﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿وجدناه﴾ is its khabar (predicate); (وجد) is a past verb, ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil, the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and (صابرًا) is the second mafʿūl bihi; ﴿نعم العبد﴾: verb and fāʿil, and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted because it is known, i.e. "he"; ﴿إنه أواب﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle, the hāʾ is its noun, and (أواب) is its khabar; the clause gives the reason for praising him.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿واذكر عبادنا إبراهيم وإسحاق ويعقوب أولي الأيدي والأبصار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (اذكر): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (عبادنا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿نا﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إبراهيم): a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); ﴿وإسحاق ويعقوب﴾: conjoined to (إبراهيم); (أولي): mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; (أولي) is ordinarily parsed as a naʿt or badal of (عبادنا)]; (الأيدي): muḍāf ilayhi; and (الأبصار): conjoined to (الأيدي).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿إنا أخلصناهم بخالصة ذكرى الدار﴾: the clause gives a reason; (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿أخلصناهم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (بخالصة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخلصناهم﴾; (بخالصة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخلصناهم﴾ [Translator's note: this sentence is repeated in the source]; (ذكرى): a badal (substitute) from (خالصة); (الدار): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the annexation of (ذكرى) to (الدار) is the annexation of the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its object, i.e. "their remembering the Abode of the Hereafter".

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وإنهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الأخيار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; (عندنا): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); ﴿من المصطفين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن); and (الأخيار): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿واذكر إسماعيل واليسع وذا الكفل وكل من الأخيار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿اذكر إسماعيل﴾: verb, latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿واليسع وذا الكفل﴾: both conjoined to (إسماعيل); (كل): mubtadaʾ (subject); and ﴿من الأخيار﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿هذا ذكر وإن للمتقين لحسن مآب﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (ذكر): khabar (predicate); (وإن): the wāw is resumptive, and (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (للمتقين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar of (إن); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (حسن): the postponed noun of (إن); (مآب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿وإن للمتقين...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t: ﴿جنات عدن مفتحة لهم الأبواب﴾: (جنات): a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of (حسن مآب); (عدن): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (مفتحة): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (جنات عدن), and what governs it is the verbal sense contained in (المتقين); (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مفتحة); and (الأبواب): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (مفتحة), because it is a passive participle, or a badal from the pronoun in (مفتحة), which is the pronoun of the Gardens.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿متكئين فيها يدعون فيها بفاكهة كثيرة وشراب﴾: (متكئين): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in (لهم), and what governs it is (مفتحة); (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿متكئين﴾; the clause ﴿يدعون﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of (يدعون), i.e. "settled in it"; (بفاكهة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يدعون﴾; (كثيرة): an adjective; and (شراب): conjoined to (فاكهة).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t: ﴿وعندهم قاصرات الطرف أتراب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); ﴿هم﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قاصرات): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); (الطرف): muḍāf ilayhi; and (أتراب): an adjective of (قاصرات).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب﴾: (هذا): the demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); (ما): khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿توعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, a clause with no grammatical position. (ليوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿توعدون﴾, and the lām is for cause, i.e. "for the sake of the Day of Reckoning"; and (الحساب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿إن هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (هذا): its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (رزقنا): khabar (predicate) of (إن); (ما): negating; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; (من): a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; and (نفاد): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ) in position, genitive (majrūr) in form by ﴿من﴾.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿هذا وإن للطاغين لشر مآب﴾: (هذا): a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "this is as mentioned", or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "the matter is this"; the statement is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the wāw is a conjunction; (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (للطاغين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar of (إن); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (شر): the postponed noun of (إن); and (مآب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد﴾: a badal (substitute) from (شر مآب), or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of it; the clause (يصلونها) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and it is an imperfect verb, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and ﴿ها﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or (جهنم) is the object of an omitted verb indicated by (يصلونها); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, i.e. "if you wish to know the reality of Hell, then it is a wretched resting place"; (بئس) is an inflexible (jāmid) verb for expressing blame, (المهاد) is the fāʿil, and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "it" (هي).

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق﴾: (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject). The fāʾ is parenthetical. The lām: the lām of command. (يذوقوه): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the lām of command. The wāw: fāʿil (agent). The hāʾ: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿فليذوقوه﴾ is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position. (حميم): khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ. (غساق): conjoined, nominative (marfūʿ).

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿وآخر من شكله أزواج﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (آخر): conjoined to ﴿حميم وغساق﴾; ﴿من شكله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of (آخر); and (أزواج): khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. "they are pairs".

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿هذا فوج مقتحم معكم لا مرحبا بهم إنهم صالو النار﴾: the clause is the speech (maqūl) of an omitted verb of saying; (هذا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (فوج): khabar (predicate); (مقتحم): an adjective of (فوج); (معكم): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second adjective of (فوج), or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in (فوج); (لا) is negating; (مرحبًا): accusative (manṣūb) as a maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿بهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مرحبًا﴾; the negated clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), ﴿هم﴾ is its noun, and ﴿صالو﴾ is its khabar, the nūn having been dropped because of the annexation; and (النار): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿قالوا بل أنتم لا مرحبا بكم أنتم قدمتموه لنا فبئس القرار﴾: (قالوا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (أنتم): mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "more deserving of the saying"; (لا) is negating; (مرحبًا): accusative (manṣūb) as a maṣdar (verbal noun); ﴿بكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مرحبًا﴾; the clause ﴿قالوا بل أنتم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (أنتم): mubtadaʾ, and the clause ﴿قدمتموه﴾ is the khabar; (قدمتموه): past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil, the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, the wāw is for lengthening the ḍamma of the mīm, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (لنا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدَّم﴾; (فبئس): the fāʾ is a conjunction, and (بئس) is an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; (القرار): fāʿil; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "the Fire".

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا في النار﴾: (قالوا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (ربنا): the one addressed (munādā), annexed, with the vocative particle omitted; (من): a relative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿قدم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) [Translator's note: so in the source; the khabar is stated below to be the clause ﴿فزده﴾, while ﴿قدم﴾ is the ṣila of (من)]; (قدم): past verb, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir); (لنا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قدم﴾; (هذا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is connective (rābiṭa) because of the scent of condition in the relative; the clause ﴿فزده﴾ is the khabar; the verb of supplication is indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi; (عذابًا): second mafʿūl bihi; (ضعفًا): a naʿt (adjective) of (عذاب), i.e. "doubled"; and (في النار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ, i.e. "so increase him, being in the Fire", or a second naʿt of (عذاب).

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿وقالوا ما لنا لا نرى رجالا كنا نعدهم من الأشرار﴾: (قالوا): verb and fāʿil (agent); (ما): an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (لنا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause ﴿لا نرى﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لا): negating; (نرى): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma, and the fāʿil of (نرى) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "we" (نحن); (رجالًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿كنا﴾: (كان) is a deficient past verb, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿كنا﴾ is an adjective of (رجالًا); the clause ﴿نعدهم﴾ is the khabar of (كان); and (من الأشرار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نعدهم﴾.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t: ﴿أتخذناهم سخريا أم زاغت عنهم الأبصار﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) has dropped, being dispensed with; (اتخذناهم): past verb, fāʿil (agent) and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (سخريًّا): second mafʿūl bihi; (أم): it is the connected «أم» (umm al-muttaṣila), a conjunction; ﴿زاغت عنهم الأبصار﴾: verb and fāʿil; (عنهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زاغت﴾; and the clause ﴿اتخذناهم﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿إن ذلك لحق تخاصم أهل النار﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and (ذلك) is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (حق): khabar (predicate) of (إن); (تخاصم): a badal (substitute) from (حق), or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "it" (هو); (أهل): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and it is itself muḍāf; (النار): muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause of the omitted mubtadaʾ and its khabar ﴿هو تخاصم﴾ is resumptive by way of explanation (bayāniyya), a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿قل إنما أنا منذر وما من إله إلا الله الواحد القهار﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (إنما): the restraining and restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (أنا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (منذر): khabar (predicate); the wāw: a conjunction; (ما): negating; (من): a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; (إله): genitive (majrūr) in form, nominative (marfūʿ) in position as the subject of the nominal sentence (bi-l-ibtidāʾ); (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the Name of Majesty: khabar; and ﴿الواحد القهار﴾: two adjectives of «الله».

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿رب السماوات والأرض وما بينهما العزيز الغفار﴾: (رب): a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty in the previous ayah, or a badal (substitute); (السماوات): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الأرض): conjoined, genitive (majrūr); (ما): a relative noun, conjoined, in the position of the genitive; (بينهما): an accusative (manṣūb) adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿العزيز الغفار﴾: also two naʿts of the Name of Majesty in the previous ayah.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿قل هو نبأ عظيم﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); ﴿هو﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject); (نبأ): khabar (predicate); and (عظيم): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿أنتم عنه معرضون﴾: the clause is a second naʿt (adjective) of (النبأ), or resumptive, with no grammatical position; (أنتم): mubtadaʾ (subject); (عنه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿معرضون﴾; and (معرضون): khabar (predicate) of (أنتم).

muyesser-irab:69-69.t: ﴿ما كان لي من علم بالملأ الأعلى إذ يختصمون﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; (ما): negating; (كان): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); (لي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (كان); (من): a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; (علم): genitive (majrūr) in form by (من), in the position of the nominative as the postponed noun of (كان); (بالملأ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (علم) on the assumption of an implied muḍāf, i.e. "of the tidings of the Exalted Assembly and their disputing"; (الأعلى): an adjective of (الملأ); (إذ): an adverb for past time, attached to an omitted [noun] annexed to (الملأ), i.e. "any knowledge of the speech of the Exalted Assembly", or a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of the accusative by the maṣdar (verbal noun) ﴿علم﴾; and the clause ﴿يختصمون﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation.

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿إن يوحى إلي إلا أنما أنا نذير مبين﴾: (إن): negating; (يوحى): imperfect verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive]; (إليّ): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يوحى﴾; (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (إنما): the restraining and restrained [particle] (kāffa wa-makfūfa), and together with what it governs it has taken the place of the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of (يوحى), i.e. "nothing is revealed to me except the warning", and the restriction is relative (iḍāfī); (أنا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (نذير): khabar (predicate); and (مبين): a naʿt (adjective). [Translator's note: the source writes «إنما» here, whereas the ayah reads ﴿أنما﴾.]

muyesser-irab:71-71.t: ﴿إذ قال ربك للملائكة إني خالق بشرا من طين﴾: (إذ): a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿إذ يختصمون﴾, or in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember" (اذكر); the clause ﴿قال ربك﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; ﴿قال ربك﴾: verb and fāʿil (agent); ﴿للملائكة﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قال﴾. ﴿إني خالق بشرًا﴾: (إن) and what follows it is the speech (maqūl) of the saying; (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the yāʾ is its noun, and (خالق) is its khabar (predicate); (بشرًا): mafʿūl bihi of (خالق); and (من طين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بشرًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t: ﴿فإذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb of future time that puts its condition in the genitive and is made accusative by its apodosis (jawāb); ﴿سويته﴾: past verb, the tāʾ: fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; (نفخت): conjoined to (سويته); (فيه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نفخت﴾, and likewise His words ﴿من روحي﴾; ﴿فقعوا﴾: the fāʾ: connective (rābiṭa) for the answer of (إذا), and (قعوا): imperative verb and fāʿil; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ساجدين﴾; and (ساجدين): ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t: ﴿فسجد الملائكة كلهم أجمعون﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; ﴿سجد الملائكة﴾: verb, fāʿil (agent); (كلهم): first tawkīd (emphasis), and the hāʾ: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (أجمعون): second tawkīd, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw.

muyesser-irab:74-74.t: ﴿إلا إبليس استكبر وكان من الكافرين﴾: (إلا): a particle of exception; (إبليس): the excepted (mustathnā), connected (muttaṣil) or disconnected (munqaṭiʿ); the clause ﴿استكبر﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position; (كان): conjoined to (استكبر), and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); and ﴿من الكافرين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of (كان).

muyesser-irab:75-75.t:
﴿قال يا إبليس ما منعك أن تسجد لما خلقت بيدي﴾: (قال): past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) refers to Allah the Exalted; (يا): vocative particle; (إبليس): the one addressed (munādā), a singular proper name, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; (ما): an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿منعك﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle that puts into the accusative; (تسجد): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (أن) and what falls within its scope is in the position of the genitive by an omitted ﴿مِن﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿منع﴾. ﴿لما خلقت بيدي﴾: the lām: a preposition; (ما): a relative noun, genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تسجد﴾; the clause ﴿خلقت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position, and the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. "I created him"; or (ما) is maṣdar-forming, and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is genitive by the lām, the maṣdar here meaning the thing created rather than the actual verbal noun; and (بيدي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلقت﴾.
﴿أستكبرت أم كنت من العالين﴾: the hamza: for interrogation, and the connecting hamza (hamzat al-waṣl) has dropped, being dispensed with. (استكبرت): verb and fāʿil; (أم): a connected (muttaṣila) conjunction; (كنت): (كان) is a deficient past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; and (من العالين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:76-76.t: ﴿قال أنا خير منه خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين﴾: (أنا): mubtadaʾ (subject); (خير): khabar (predicate); (منه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خير﴾; the clause is the speech (maqūl) of the saying; (خلقتني): verb, fāʿil (agent) and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (من نار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلق﴾; and ﴿خلقته من طين﴾: conjoined to ﴿خلقتني من نار﴾.

muyesser-irab:77-77.t: ﴿قال فاخرج منها فإنك رجيم﴾: (قال): past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو), referring to Allah the Exalted; (فاخرج): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and (اخرج) is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اخرج﴾; (فإنك): the fāʾ gives the reason (taʿlīliyya), (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), the kāf is its noun, and (رجيم) is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:78-78.t: ﴿وإن عليك لعنتي إلى يوم الدين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إن): a particle of emphasis that puts into the accusative; (عليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (إن); (لعنتي): the postponed noun of (إن), and the yāʾ: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إلى يوم الدين): the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "continuing"; and (الدين): muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:79-79.t: ﴿قال رب فأنظرني إلى يوم يبعثون﴾: (قال): past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring to Iblīs; ﴿فأنظرني﴾: the fāʾ: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it discloses (afṣaḥat) an implied condition, its implied form being ﴿إذا جعلتني رجيمًا فأمهلني﴾ ("since You have made me accursed, then grant me respite"); (أنظرني): a verb of supplication, the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "You" (أنت), the nūn is for protection (nūn al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إلى يوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنظرني﴾; and the clause ﴿يبعثون﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.

muyesser-irab:80-80.t: ﴿قال فإنك من المنظرين﴾: (قال): past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); (فإنك): the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the kāf is its noun; and (من المنظرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of (إن).

muyesser-irab:81-81.t: ﴿إلى يوم الوقت المعلوم﴾: (إلى يوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿المنظرين﴾; (الوقت): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and (المعلوم): a naʿt (adjective) of (الوقت), genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:82-82.t: ﴿قال فبعزتك لأغوينهم أجمعين﴾: (قال): verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the fāʾ: a conjunction; the bāʾ: a preposition and particle of oath; (عزتك): genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of oath; the lām: occurring in the answer to the oath; the clause ﴿أغوينهم﴾ has no grammatical position; (أغوينهم): imperfect verb, with a latent fāʿil, its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and (أجمعين): tawkīd (emphasis).

muyesser-irab:83-83.t: ﴿إلا عبادك منهم المخلصين﴾: (إلا): a particle of exception; (عبادك): excepted (mustathnā); (منهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (المخلصين): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿عبادك﴾.

muyesser-irab:84-84.t: ﴿قال فالحق والحق أقول﴾: (قال): verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); the fāʾ: resumptive; (الحق): mubtadaʾ (subject), whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "is My oath" or "is from Me"; or the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "it is the truth". The clause ﴿فالحق...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. ﴿والحق﴾: the wāw is parenthetical, and (الحق) is a fronted object of ﴿أقول﴾, i.e. "I say nothing but the truth". The clause ﴿الحق أقول﴾ is parenthetical between the oath and its answer, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿لأملأن جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم أجمعين﴾: the lām: occurring in the answer to the implied (muqaddar) oath; (أملأن): imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, the nūn being for emphasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); (جهنم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أملأن﴾ is the answer to an implied oath, and the clause of the oath is in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) from (الحق), or resumptive by way of explanation (bayāniyya), with no grammatical position; (منك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أملأن﴾; ﴿ممن تبعك﴾: conjoined to ﴿منك﴾; the clause ﴿تبعك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. (منهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and (أجمعين): tawkīd (emphasis) of the pronoun in (منهم), or of the kāf in (منك) and what is conjoined to it.

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿قل ما أسألكم عليه من أجر وما أنا من المتكلفين﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); (ما): negating; (أسألكم): imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا), and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally an adjective of (أجر) and was placed before it; (من): a connective (ṣila) preposition [i.e. redundant]; (أجر): genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position as the object of (أسألكم); the wāw: a conjunction or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (ما): the Ḥijāzī negating «ما», which operates as «ليس» operates; (أنا): the noun of (ما); and ﴿من المتكلفين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of (ما). Or ﴿ما﴾ is negating, ﴿أنا﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and ﴿من المتكلفين﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t: ﴿إن هو إلا ذكر للعالمين﴾: (إن): negating; (هو): mubtadaʾ (subject); (إلا): a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (ذكر): khabar (predicate) of (هو); and (للعالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of (ذكر).

muyesser-irab:88-88.t: ﴿ولتعلمن نبأه بعد حين﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; the lām: the lām of oath; (تعلمن): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), because the nūn of emphasis is not directly attached to it, and the sign of its nominative is the presence of the nūn, which has been dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the wāw, also dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters: fāʿil (agent); the nūn: the heavy nūn of emphasis; (نبأه): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بعد): an accusative (manṣūb) adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تعلمن﴾; and (حين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
